evidence.field: File description; SVG path inspected in the repository copy
evidence.text: The Commons page identifies 山-seal.svg as a vector depiction of 山 in Shuowen seal-script style and states that the file is CC0 1.0. The local SVG path describes three upright strokes joined by a curved base; the central stroke extends below the side strokes. This supports revising the caption and alt text to match that shape. The Commons description also identifies its source references, so the drawing should be treated as a modern vector redraw, not an ancient artifact image.
evidence.kind: file description and local SVG geometry
evidence.title: File:山-seal.svg

evidence.source: Academia Sinica Institute of Information Science, Chinese Character Database
evidence.text: The character record calls 山 a pictograph depicting mountain peaks standing together and lists oracle-bone, bronze, Chu-script manuscript, small-seal and 說文 forms. It gives bronze references 集成05396 and 金文詁林索引9.245. The page does not date each specimen or establish a continuous stroke-by-stroke derivation.
evidence.title: 漢字「山」：字形演變

evidence.source: 許慎《說文解字》 entry with 段玉裁 commentary, online transcription
evidence.text: The transcription gives the historical dictionary account that 山 disperses qi, gives rise to things, is high and rocky, and is pictographic. Duan Yucai comments on the wording and notes a textual emendation for 𢿱. This documents a historical lexicographic interpretation, not independent proof of original formation or sense.
evidence.title: 說文解字「山」
